sn4.14:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati ekasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme.
sn4.14:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti.
sn4.14:2.2: ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti
sn4.14:2.3: yannūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo tenusaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyāti.
sn4.14:2.4: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhābhāsi
sn4.14:5.1: atha kho māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ bhagavā jānāti maṃ sugatoti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
